snippet.title: ZPF | Official Launch Trailer | Coming Soon to Digital (Steam, NSW, & Xbox)
snippet.description:
Warp into retro-futuristic mayhem!

The Kickstarter-crushing #SHMUP that took the Genesis and Mega Drive by storm is finally warping onto modern platforms! #ZPF arrives digitally on April 16, 2026.

Experience a fever dream of mind-melting visuals, endless layers of parallax, and the kind of relentless arcade gameplay that defined an era. Choose your pilot—Gladius, Gold, or Knight—and soar through vibrant dreamscapes to tear through nightmarish foes.

Wishlist now!
Steam: https://bit.ly/MCSZPFV
Nintendo Switch: https://bit.ly/ZPFNSWY
Xbox One & Xbox Series X|S: https://bit.ly/MCSZPFXV

Developed by the ZPF Team | published by Mega Cat Studios

🔗 More about the game here: https://bit.ly/MCS-ZPF
For more on Mega Cat Studios and our games, please visit: https://megacatstudios.com
Come play & talk on Discord: http://discord.com/invite/megacat

⚡Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more ZPF updates!

#RetroGaming #ShootEmUp #Xbox #NintendoSwitch #Steam
